review_notes: I read the whole target file. I compared it with the corresponding generated StandardComodule files for TypeD and E6, and I grepped for the same lemma in E7 and D4. Inside this file there is no repeated proof machinery, because each lemma is used once. The only repeated machinery is across sibling files. The `hcomp`/`hpoint` block from the target lemma at lines 89–100 appears with the same shape in TypeD, E6 and, per the grep, probably E7 and D4. I did not read the E7 or D4 bodies in full. I did not check whether a generic `mapDomain` lemma already exists elsewhere; my grep of the library found none. I have not compiled the proposed lemma. The sibling files differ in how they finish the proof, so a shared lemma covers only the first part. Elaboration details such as `no_index` and `erw` could affect a rewrite.

findings.problem: The proof first shows `hcomp`, which says the generated map composed with the root lift equals the ambient coordinate map composed with the transported root map. It then turns `hcomp` into an equality of points with `WithConv.ext; ext x; simp only [BialgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply]; exact congrArg (fun f ↦ q.ofConv (f.hom x)) hcomp`. That second step is about `BialgHom.mapDomain` and point precomposition and has nothing to do with type B. The TypeD, E6 and (per grep) E7 and D4 files repeat it with only the names changed. The TypeD file has the same `hcomp` block, the same `hpoint` block and the same `simp only [BialgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply]; exact congrArg ...` closing step. So the argument is repeated in several proofs and each copy has to be maintained separately.
findings.proposed_change: Add one generic lemma in the shared points or `BialgHom.mapDomain` API. It would be stated for Hopf algebra homs `π : X ⟶ G` and `c : X ⟶ C`, lifts `l : G ⟶ Y` and `r : C ⟶ Y`, and a point `q` of `Y`. The hypothesis is `h : π ≫ l = c ≫ r`. The conclusion is `BialgHom.mapDomain π.hom (toConv (q.ofConv.comp l.hom.toAlgHom)) = BialgHom.mapDomain c.hom (toConv (q.ofConv.comp r.hom.toAlgHom))`. The proof is the existing `WithConv.ext; ext x; simp only [BialgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply]; exact congrArg (fun f ↦ q.ofConv (f.hom x)) h`. The target proof would become `rw [mapDomain_toConv_comp_eq (hcomp) q]`, followed by the existing `hcarrier`/`hmatrix` rewrites. The TypeD, E6, E7 and D4 variants would use the same lemma and delete their `hpoint` copies. The lemma has to sit where `BialgHom.mapDomain` and `HopfAlgebra.points` are both available. This is a small API lemma with hypotheses that fit all the callers.
findings.benefit: One reusable lemma replaces about ten lines in each of at least five spin or minuscule generated-subgroup files. Each proof then reads as `hcomp`, transport, and the matrix identification, which is the part that actually differs per family. Fixes to the `mapDomain` or `ext` behaviour happen in one place.
